import sys

def mod_pow(b, e, m):
    b %= m
    res = 1
    while e > 0:
        if (e & 1) == 1:
            res = (res * b) % m
        b = (b * b) % m
        e >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    k = n * m
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    length = r - l + 1
    MOD = 998244353

    if k % 2 == 1:
        ans = mod_pow(length, k, MOD)
    else:
        t1 = mod_pow(length, k, MOD)
        t2 = mod_pow(length % 2, k, MOD)
        ans = (t1 + t2) % MOD
        ans = ans * mod_pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
